messages:
michael_partnerships: Quick check — we need a final freeze on partner press assets and SI partner talking points. Proposed embargo window: Mon May 22 16:00 UTC -> Tue May 23 00:00 UTC. Thoughts?

carlos_marketing: That window works for press teams in NA/EU. APAC will be earlier morning — is that ok? :earth_asia:

sana_product: We should avoid overlapping with the new-dedicated-announcement on 23rd PST. Can we shift embargo end to 01:00 UTC to give a buffer?

michael_partnerships: Good point. +1 to extending end to 01:00 UTC. Means partners get regionally consistent timing.

jordan_eng: From infra side, staging cutover needs a 2h maintenance window before embargo. Proposed staging slot: `2026-05-22 12:00-14:00 UTC` for final migrations and smoke tests.

alexa_pm: I can own microsite cutover. Need final hero copy and partner logos by Fri May 19 EOD (UTC). Who's owning partner logo refresh?

michael_partnerships: I'll chase the SI leads for logos. Target to collect by Thu May 18. If we miss, alexa_pm will use placeholders — please keep CMS placeholders ready.

carlos_marketing: Press kit owners: @carlos_marketing (press release), @sana_product (technical FAQ), @michael_partnerships (partner quotes). Legal review required before we circulate.

legal-bot: Reminder: Legal signoff required for partner quotes and case studies. Deadline: 2026-05-20 18:00 UTC. Upload docs to /legal/review/marketplace-launch.

sana_product: For SI responsibilities — Jordan, can you confirm a contact matrix? We need who does tenant onboarding, who handles post-activation checks, and escalation path.

jordan_eng: Yes — matrix below (short):
- Tenant provisioning: SI Tier1 -> onboarding-api team (oncall)
- Post-activation health checks: SI Tier2 -> infra-sre
- Escalations: SI PMs -> eng-platform lead
I'll drop a formal spreadsheet into the shared drive today.

alexa_pm: Rehearsal/dry-run: Can we schedule a full run with press ops and SI leads? Suggest May 21 08:00 UTC — 1.5h (microsite cutover, redirect smoke tests, press release push simulation).

carlos_marketing: Works for us. Will invite press ops and PR agency.

michael_partnerships: I'll invite SI leads and include the tenant onboarding checklist in the invite.

legal-bot: Note: embargo exceptions must be requested by May 20 12:00 UTC. Approvals may take up to 24h.

deploy-bot: Dry-run scheduled: 2026-05-21 08:00 UTC. Staging slot reserved: 2026-05-22 12:00-14:00 UTC. Notifying eng-oncall.

carlos_marketing: Action items recap:
- alexa_pm: microsite cutover ops + placeholders ready (owner)
- michael_partnerships: collect partner logos by 2026-05-18
- sana_product: publish technical FAQ draft by 2026-05-19
- legal-bot: finalize signoff by 2026-05-20 18:00 UTC
- jordan_eng: contact matrix + spreadsheet today
- deploy-bot: run dry-run and staging reservations confirmed

michael_partnerships: Thanks — let's sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC for a quick checkpoint. :thumbsup:
